color.note: Original Ingredi palette: white page, softly green-tinted surfaces, forest-green actions, and lime accents. Layout, elevation, spacing, and interaction patterns remain unchanged.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: plain white. Every screen sits on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Warm off-white for objects on the page: cards, list groups, summary rows, sheets, modals, popups. Separated from bg by tone alone, no border, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Filled controls on the white page: inputs, search, unselected chips, secondary buttons, segmented track, image placeholders.

tokens.name: fill-on-surface
tokens.usage: Controls and tags inside a softly tinted card or lime box: secondary buttons, tags, and the Join Group pill.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1px hairline between rows inside one list group and above the tab bar. Never around a component.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Strongest text: screen titles, headings, card titles, and key numbers. Original deep green-black, not pure black.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, chat messages, list-row labels (8.4:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata and helper text: distance, time, counts (5.9:1 on bg, 5.2:1 on surface-muted).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Quietest readable text: timestamps, placeholders, inactive tab labels, on bg or surface (4.6:1 or more). Not on surface-muted.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Always paired with a reduced-opacity or flat-fill disabled shape.

tokens.name: text-on-primary
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on primary fills: buttons, selected chips, active tab pill, badges (4.8:1).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels on lime fills such as reward badges and points. Deep green in both themes.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on the dark toast.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Original forest-green action color: primary buttons, selected chips, badges, progress fill, selected pins, and the active tab.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover (web).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Forest-green links and emphasized text on the page or surface.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Soft green wash: my chat bubble, selected cards, and the active tab pill.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The lime-green period in the Ingredi wordmark and decorative brand accents.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime accent: points, rewards, and decorative highlights.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The original pale-lime box used for meal-swap groups, rewards, and milestone banners.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Lime-family text on the page or a surface, including points earned.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: 'Shared', 'Added to fridge'. The only place green appears.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success banner backgrounds.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expiry warnings ('2 days left'). Always with a clock or alert icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banner and 'expiring' tag background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or explicit label.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error field fill, destructive button fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: 'You are here' on the map, Wanted posts, tips.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info banner and 'Wanted' tag background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring only (2px, 2px offset). Appears on focus, never at rest.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map base layer.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map roads.

tokens.name: map-block
tokens.usage: Map building blocks.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Map parks and campus green.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: greetings, reward moments ('Shared with Jack!').

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen titles on tab roots (Home, Cook, Nearby, Message, My).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Detail-page titles (recipe, post, group) and sheet titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen. Medium, not semibold, so sections stay calm.

styles.name: points
styles.usage: Point balance and big counters. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, list-row primary text, names in chat.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bought too many: 3 ripe avocados, best this week.
styles.usage: Default reading text, descriptions, messages. Color text-body.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in cards and rows, helper text. Color text-secondary.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, tag labels, tab labels, timestamps. Color text-secondary or text-tertiary. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and primary link labels. 14px variant for small buttons.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Rare uppercase labels above grouped stats. Not for headings.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screen gutters are space-4; gaps between sections space-6 or space-7.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between avatar stack and label, inner gap of small rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a carousel, list-row inner gap, card padding for compact cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, default card padding, gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet padding, roomy card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections on tab-root screens (Home, Cook).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding under the status bar area, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Reward hero spacing, illustration breathing room.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large empty states.

radius.note: Rounded and soft, never sharp. Larger elements get larger radii.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small thumbnails, checkboxes, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list-row thumbnails, toast, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, post cards, recipe cards, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), modals, hero cards, reward card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search bar, avatars, pins, segmented control.

stroke.note: No outlines. Lines exist only as row dividers, the keyboard focus ring and icon strokes.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside one list group (divider color).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (focus color, 2px offset).

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke at 24px: 1.5px at 20px, 2px at 32px.

shadow.note: Almost no shadows. Cards and popups separate from the white page by their off-white tone. Shadows are only for things that float over imagery, maps or the page.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything on the page: cards, list groups, buttons (including primary), chips, inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Controls that sit over a photo or map: back / save buttons on a recipe image, the search bar over the map, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating controls: FAB, map pins, the List/Map toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Layers above the page: bottom sheet, modal, toast (together with scrim).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on every interactive element.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Large (default) button height.

tokens.name: button-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small button inside cards. Its touch area still extends to 44px.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: Search bar.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Filter and choice chips (padded to a 44px hit area).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the home-indicator safe area.

tokens.name: topnav-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar below the status bar.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, small buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in list rows and post headers.
